headline: Fleming begins Casino Royale
summary: Ian Fleming starts writing the first Bond novel at his Jamaican home, Goldeneye.

headline: First screen Bond
summary: CBS broadcasts a one-hour 'Climax!' adaptation of Casino Royale, with Barry Nelson as an American 'Jimmy' Bond.

headline: Broccoli and Saltzman form Eon Productions
summary: Albert R. Broccoli and Harry Saltzman partner to bring Bond to the big screen. (Date approximate: month-level.)

headline: Ian Fleming dies
summary: Fleming dies at 56, weeks before Goldfinger premieres.

headline: Daniel Craig announced as Bond
summary: Daniel Craig is unveiled as the sixth actor to play 007 in Eon's series.

headline: Amazon agrees to acquire MGM
summary: Amazon announces an $8.45B deal for MGM, home of the Bond franchise's distribution rights.

headline: Amazon completes MGM acquisition
summary: The deal closes, bringing Bond under Amazon MGM Studios.

headline: Amazon MGM takes creative control
summary: Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson hand over creative control of the franchise to Amazon MGM Studios.

headline: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond
summary: Amazon MGM Studios announces Robert Pattinson as the seventh actor to play 007, starring in Bond 26. Denis Villeneuve directs, with Amy Pascal and David Heyman producing.
